notes.title: ROTA Will Remain Free
notes.notes: [p]When I first released ROTA on Steam, it was a paid game.[/p][p]After a while I asked Valve to make it a free game.[/p][p]I am now being told I can not make it a paid game once again.[/p][p]ROTA will remain free forever ![/p][p]Enjoy <3[/p]

notes.title: Price Increase to $4.99 USD
notes.notes: [p]ROTA: Bend Gravity will cost $4.99 USD on Monday, June 23, 2025[/p][p]Everyono who has installed and played the game will own a permament license.[/p][p]Download and play ROTA: Bend Gravity for free while you can ![/p][p]After Monday, June 23, 2025 new users will have to buy the game for $4.99 USD.[/p]

notes.title: Cute gravity-bending platformer ROTA is now free and open source
notes.notes:
Always nice to see more developers open up their games. ROTA released back in 2022 is now not only free, but it's also been made open source by the dev.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/04/cute-gravity-bending-platformer-rota-is-now-free-and-open-source

notes.title: ROTA is now FREE !
notes.notes:
ROTA is now 100% FREE!
Available now on itch.io - [url=https://harmonyhoney.itch.io/rota]https://harmonyhoney.itch.io/rota[/url]
Pending approval ROTA will be free on Steam soon!

ROTA is Open Source - [url=https://github.com/HarmonyHoney/ROTA]https://github.com/HarmonyHoney/ROTA[/url]

notes.title: Patch 6 - High Refresh Rate Support! (=
notes.notes:
This update brings two new Options in the Menu:

[list]
[*] Interpolation
[*] Frame Limit
[/list]
Interpolation will smooth out player movement on higher refresh rate displays!
Frame limit can limit the maximum Frames Per Second of the game (:

Thanks to [url=https://github.com/HarmonyHoney/ROTA/pull/1]this pull request[/url] by [url=https://github.com/neropatti]neropatti[/url]! <3

notes.title: Breath of Life Update - Patch 5
notes.notes:
New friends have arrived in ROTA! The Sun, Moon and Stars have come along with them...
ROTA is now populated with curious characters eager to meet you! Have a chat between puzzles!
Clouds have filled with sky, bringing weather like rain and snow falling gently to the ground.


Breath of Life Update - Patch 5 Changes:

[list]
[*] New Characters moved in, populating ROTA!
[*] Chat with folks and get to know them (;
[*] Connect stray worlds and bring people together!

[*] Dynamic Weather System! Clouds fill the sky with falling Rain & Snow...
[*] Day & Night! Watch the Sun rise and Moon fall.
[*] Dynamic Lighting and Shadows! Illuminated by the Burning Star in Orbit.
[*] Stars come out at night! Twinkling in the distance...
[*] Background depth with Parallax layers!

[*] Doors hold a Vortex, sucking in travelers and spitting them out the other end!
[*] Door closing Sound Effect.
[*] World Door Unlock Cutscene! Combine the power of Gems and fill the socket...

[*] All Menus overhauled! Simple & Clean.
[*] Pause Menu minified. The world keeps moving...
[*] UI animation improved when collecting a Gem or Clock!
[*] Hair physics rework! Smoother motions when swaying in the breeze (;
[*] Radial Blur effect with help from Guy Unger! <3

[*] Player D-Pad & Joystick input issues fixed! Movement feels more responsive.
[*] Camera speed V-Sync issue fixed!
[*] Performance improvements! Ignoring many objects off-screen.
[/list]

notes.title: ROTA is a cute and colourful gravity-bending puzzle-platformer worth a look
notes.notes:
It might look colourful and inviting but don't let that fool you, ROTA is going to test your brain with its gravity-defying puzzle mechanics.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/05/rota-is-a-cute-and-colourful-gravity-bending-puzzle-platformer-worth-a-look
